findings.quote: GoGo lets you book rides and order groceries and meals by phone, with no smartphone app. You call or text us, we book the ride with a driver service, and we keep an eye on the trip.
Your membership automatically renews every month unless you cancel.
You can cancel any time with no fee. To cancel, call us, email us, or cancel online in your account settings.
Our Terms include an arbitration agreement and a class action waiver, so disputes go to individual arbitration instead of court.
Walter, do you authorize GoGoGrandparent to charge your Visa ending in 8803 for the Value plan today and every month until you cancel?
